    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",

  {

   "id": "c8747c52",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_transmembrane_tendency)=\n",
    "# Get transmembrane tendency\n",
    "\n",
    "*Evaluating amino acid insertion and propensity scores for lipid membranes.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_transmembrane_tendency` returns empirical free-energy insertion propensities for residues in lipid bilayers using two published scales:\n",
    "- `'zhao'`: Free-energy-based insertion scale from Zhao & London (2006).\n",
    "- `'senes'`: Statistical pseudo-potential scale from Senes et al. (2007).\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_transmembrane_tendency`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "91c272a2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "By default (`definition='zhao'`), free-energy-based insertion tendencies into lipid bilayers are reported (positive values indicate membrane preference, negative values indicate aqueous preference):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "90bd1594",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:04.763521Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:04.763250Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.940126Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.933868Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "192badd9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.943716Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.943101Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:12.936494Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:12.935247Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5588744e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "37b90cfc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We query the Zhao & London transmembrane propensity scores and plot the sequence profile:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "bb3c6f10",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:12.945748Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:12.944972Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:13.537449Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:13.536159Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "tt = msm.physchem.get_transmembrane_tendency(molsys, element='group', definition='zhao')\n",
    "group_names = msm.get(molsys, element='group', name=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))\n",
    "colors = ['darkorange' if val > 0 else 'royalblue' for val in tt]\n",
    "ax.bar(range(len(tt)), tt, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)\n",
    "ax.axhline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(range(len(tt)))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(group_names, rotation=45, fontsize=8)\n",
    "ax.set_title('Transmembrane Tendency Profile (Zhao & London)')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Residue')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Propensity Index')\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, axis='y')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5d88e94d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Alternative transmembrane scales\n",
    "\n",
    "Setting `definition='senes'` extracts statistical pseudo-potential propensities derived from transmembrane helix structures:\n"
   ]
  },

    "tt_senes = msm.physchem.get_transmembrane_tendency(molsys, element='group', definition='senes')\n",
    "print('Senes propensity scores:\\n', tt_senes)\n"
   ]
